exampleEn: I think we should call it a day and continue tomorrow.
exampleKo: 우리는 오늘은 여기까지 하고 내일 계속하는 게 좋을 것 같아.
gameExamples: After working for hours, we decided to call it a day.
It's getting late, so let's call it a day and head home.
We accomplished a lot today, so I think it's time to call it a day.
